exposure: New Japanese diagnostic criteria for obstetrical DIC (tentative version)
Pregnancy-specific modified International Society on Thrombosis and Hemostasis DIC score (pregnancy-specific modified ISTH DIC score)
outcome: Scores of underlying diseases (particularly postpartum hemorrhage with coagulopathy)
Rates of platelet concentrate (PC) transfusion therapy
Rates of fresh frozen plasma and/or cryoprecipitate, red blood cell, and PC transfusions
cohort: All participants were women retrospectively diagnosed with obstetrical disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC) using both the new Japanese criteria and the pregnancy-specific modified ISTH DIC score.
finding: The new Japanese diagnostic criteria detected more severe cases of obstetrical DIC compared with the pregnancy-specific modified ISTH DIC score.
